answer: A wharf registry requires each agent to pay a nonrefundable 10-token fee and lock 500 tokens for 30 days per marble identity, verified by a registry receipt; N fake keys cost 10N tokens irreversibly plus 500N tokens locked linearly. Reset cannot reuse the lockup: the old key is burned and an opal-marked new key pays another 10-token fee and fresh 500-token deposit.
